trust_decision.summary: Whether a record in an uploaded backup/relocation export may be turned into a model instance (which runs each field's to_python, including GzippedDictField's pickle fallback) is decided by model-kind/exclusion/scope checks; at the pinned commit those checks run only AFTER Django's deserializer has already built the instance, in import_by_model and in the org-filter pre-pass of _import.

landing_point.why: Summary names the Relocation feature; its importing task is the one place relocation hands the uploaded export to the backup importer (import_in_organization_scope). A pickle-first reader would instead land on src/sentry/db/models/fields/gzippeddict.py:39.

fix_sites.entry_point: import_in_organization_scope(org_filter=...) -> _import org-slug filter pre-pass; reached from relocation importing task (src/sentry/relocation/tasks/process.py:1413-1422), CLI `sentry import organizations --filter-org-slugs` (src/sentry/runner/commands/backup.py:762), and the Cloud Build validation step (src/sentry/relocation/utils.py:720-728)

ImportExportService.import_by_model RPC (src/sentry/backup/services/import_export/service.py:52-54), called per batch by _import.do_write (src/sentry/backup/imports.py:360-368) for every import_in_*_scope: CLI import users/organizations/config/global (src/sentry/runner/commands/backup.py:690,762,832,896) and relocation importing task
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level hybrid-cloud RPC service implementation (backup/services/import_export package)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For impl.py: it is an internal RPC service that already rejects non-BaseModel/excluded/out-of-scope models and only writes allowed ones, so it 'looks validated'; for imports.py:197: it is a read-only filter pass that only looks at org slugs and members and writes nothing, so it 'cannot import anything'. Both miss that building the instance itself runs the pickle fallback.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: GzippedDictField must still read legacy pickled+compressed rows coming from the database (from_db_value -> to_python pickle fallback); removing the pickle fallback outright closes the import sink but breaks reading old GroupTombstone.data rows. Also: in-scope models must still import, unknown fields must still be tolerated (ignorenonexistent), and org-slug filtering must still select the right orgs and their members' users.

O6_input_shapes: record of an Excluded-scope Sentry model carrying a GzippedDictField (GroupTombstone) in its own batch
record whose model is outside the batch's expected model (mismatch) — now rejected before deserialize
record of a non-BaseModel / EXCLUDED_APPS model (auth, contenttypes, fixtures) — now rejected before deserialize
record of a model whose possible relocation scopes do not intersect the import scope — now skipped before deserialize
any record placed before the first OrganizationMember in the org-filter pre-pass — pre-pass now reads raw dicts only

O7_producer.where: Django serializers.deserialize at src/sentry/backup/services/import_export/impl.py:213 and src/sentry/backup/imports.py:197 invoking field to_python at src/sentry/db/models/fields/gzippeddict.py:31-39

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a relocatable (User/Organization scope) model carrying a legacy GzippedDictField, so the fix's pre-checks pass and the deserializer still runs the pickle fallback
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GzippedDictField is a legacy field kept for old rows (gzippeddict.py:17-21); many relocatable models carry legacy blob fields (e.g. LegacyTextJSONField at src/sentry/models/rule.py:51, src/sentry/models/projectkey.py:125); a maintainer could leave one unmigrated. HOW-type: needs the insight that the sink is field conversion, not the scope check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: preprocessing_scan building model instances via Django's deserializer to read org slugs/usernames instead of raw json dicts
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same job as the _import org-filter pre-pass, which used serializers.deserialize at the pinned commit (src/sentry/backup/imports.py:197); a second implementation in another package (relocation).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: `sentry backup compare`/`sanitize` loading exports into model instances via Django serializers for model-aware comparison
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both commands parse the same export format (backup.py:414, backup.py:591) and a model-aware comparator is a plausible refactor.

O9_family: CWE-502 deserialization of untrusted data (pickle reached via ORM field conversion during Django JSON deserialization; check-after-use ordering)

O10_build.toolchain: Python 3 + Django, pip/uv per repo requirements; pytest

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete the pickle.loads fallback in GzippedDictField.to_python (or only reorder checks in impl.py), leaving either legacy DB reads broken or the imports.py org-filter pre-pass still building instances.

out_of_scope_notes: Other pickle.loads sinks exist in unrelated features (src/sentry/services/nodestore/django/backend.py:33, src/sentry/buffer/redis.py:546-559, src/sentry/digests/codecs.py:19); not on the import path.
impl.py:227 condition `app_label not in EXCLUDED_APPS or model_instance` is always truthy for a model instance, so the excluded-apps check was ineffective at the pinned commit (the fix replaces it).
